tip: Aucun normally means 'none', but d'aucuns flips it: an old plural for 'some people'. D'aucuns diront = some will say.
Est-il here isn't a question – French inverts the verb after certain set openers. Toujours est-il que = the fact remains that.
Vaille is the subjunctive of valoir (to be worth), frozen twice: vaille que vaille literally 'be it worth what it may' = come what may.
